_doc: Villagers' tastes (Tastes, scripts/systems/tastes.gd). Each villager likes some pieces and some paint colours. A piece they like, or a piece painted a colour they like, put up within `radius` metres of their spot (`near`: one of the layout's hangouts, or [x, z]) earns a heart and their `line` once a day ({piece} is the piece's name). The morning paper gives away one taste nobody has heard yet (`gossip`), and the bag lists the tastes you know. At an inauguration, a villager who likes a piece in what's opened cheers for it.

fern.line: Oh, a {piece}! You do know me.
fern.gossip: Overheard: Gigia can't walk past a hedge without patting it. Green paint makes her weep.

bram.line: A {piece}! Proper wiring, I hope. Lovely.
bram.gossip: Overheard: Elio stops to admire every lamp in the village, lit or not. Yellow is his favourite colour. He says it's 'the colour of current'.

percival.gossip: Overheard: the Sindaco believes every village needs more columns and statues. Red, he says, is the colour of leadership.

tilly.line: Ooh, a {piece}! That's going on the website.
tilly.gossip: Overheard: Fede photographs every sign and windmill for the website. Blue and lilac, she says, look best on a screen.

mabel.line: A {piece}! My customers will love it.
mabel.gossip: Overheard: Ornella wants benches and tables everywhere people might eat bread. Which is everywhere. And she adores pink.

captain.line: A {piece}, at my stop! Now that's a service.
captain.gossip: Overheard: Aldo would like a bench and a roof at every bus stop in the province. Painted bus blue, ideally.

river_town_ermes.line: A {piece}. Sensible. The river respects sensible.
river_town_ermes.gossip: Overheard: Ermes trusts anything that could stop a flood: sandbags, stone, railings, a good streetlight. Dark slate is the only honest colour, he says.

river_town_tullio.gossip: Overheard: in forty years Tullio has said more about pontoons and benches by the water than about anything else. He likes teal, like the river.

river_town_primo.line: A {piece}! Now that's something a cyclist can use.
river_town_primo.gossip: Overheard: Primo says a town is only as good as its streetlights and signposts for cyclists. And everything should be racing green.

river_town_gildo.line: A {piece}, right where I can watch for him.
river_town_gildo.gossip: Overheard: Gildo wants a bench and a lantern by the water, to watch for the monster. Brown, like an old boat.

river_town_mattia.gossip: Overheard: Mattia pretends not to care, but he stops for anything electric: lamps, windmills, signs. Light blue, if you ask.

river_town_wanda.gossip: Overheard: Wanda says every dance hall needs lamps, flowers and somewhere to swoon. Pink or lilac, never beige.

river_town_rina.line: A {piece}. More customers, more card games. Good.
river_town_rina.gossip: Overheard: Rina could always use more tables and chairs for the card players. Green, like the bar's awning.

river_town_ines.line: A {piece}. Poplar, I hope, and not a scrap wasted.
river_town_ines.gossip: Overheard: Ines likes honest woodwork: fences, wooden walls, tables, beams. Plain wood brown, of course.

river_town_pierina.line: A {piece}! A nice spot to stop for coffee.
river_town_pierina.gossip: Overheard: Pierina stops at every bench and flower bed on her round. Yellow, like her jacket.

rice_village_ernesto.line: A {piece}. Regulation, that. The railway would approve, if it ever came.
rice_village_ernesto.gossip: Overheard: Paletta says a proper station wants lanterns, an enamel sign and flower beds. Signal red and green, of course.

rice_village_battista.gossip: Overheard: Barba Tista only trusts things that keep water where it belongs: stone, fences, levers and pumps. Mud brown never shows the dirt, he says.

rice_village_pierina.line: Oh, a {piece}! In 1951 we'd have given an arm for one.
rice_village_pierina.gossip: Overheard: Nonna Pierina says the edge of a paddy wants flowers, trees and somewhere to sit. And bright pink, whatever her son says.

rice_village_silvia.line: A {piece}! That's what gets a mill turning.
rice_village_silvia.gossip: Overheard: Silvia lights up at anything with a gear in it: waterwheels, shafts, a good workbench. Rice-shoot green, she says, is the future.

rice_village_remo.line: A {piece}. Blessed, I'd say. Don't tell the bishop.
rice_village_remo.gossip: Overheard: Don Remo says a churchyard wants lamps, pillars and the odd statue. White and gold, like his Christmas vestments.

rice_village_matteo.line: A {piece}! I'm writing it down in my log.
rice_village_matteo.gossip: Overheard: Matteo wants railway things by the crossing: lanterns, signposts, enamel signs. Yellow, like the inspection train.
